frigate.notes: Night Owl cameras stream through the Night Owl DVR/NVR — point Frigate at the recorder's IP, one channel per camera: /ch01/0 (main) and /ch01/1 (sub), where 01 is the channel number. No direct-to-camera ONVIF/RTSP. RTSP path from the community RTSP-patterns layer (issue #268).

features: add-on for FTN8 / AN12 series recorder
release_notes: Night Owl CAM-FTN8-MT-B: a ruggedized 4K wired-IP (PoE) deterrence dome camera with a motion-activated spotlight and two-way audio; add-on for Night Owl FTN8/AN12 series NVRs. Consumer product-page specs — Night Owl does not publish sensor/lens details; unlisted fields omitted, form-factor from the product listing.
